name: dspark-domain-drafters-pilot
purpose: Smoke of the per-domain pipeline on the data campaign's pilot slice: every step, tiny budget. Not a result.

initializer.rebinding: Copy config.json with speculators_config.verifier.name_or_path set to the contract's authorized_checkpoint (the original points at an inaccessible private snapshot of the same revision); weights and other files are symlinks to the original.

data.format: Trace rows {id, prompt_ids, generated_ids, finish_reason} generated by Apertus 1.5 8B (thinking off) from the sibling data campaign (MANIFEST.json there). Converted as in the adaptation repeat: input_ids = prompt + completion, loss on the completion only; nothing re-tokenized; hidden states extracted online.

opb.derivation: First 512 corpus rows whose id is in Yu's val_ids.txt, in corpus order: the first 512 rows of the earlier heldout.jsonl (scratch copy wiped by the cleaner). Sanity check: e10 OPB eal should reproduce the adaptation repeat's 6.269.

training.budget_basis: Every head takes 384 optimizer steps of 2 ranks x 9,344 packed tokens = 7.18M input tokens (equal token budget, not equal rows; rows per step vary with the domain's mean length and are reported). epochs=4 is only a cap so short-row domains can pass the data more than once; the head is the first checkpoint at global_step 384.
training.learning_rate_basis: The adaptation repeat at 3e-5 (constant) moved DSpark dev EAL only +0.30 and served +3-9%; DSpark e10 was trained at peak 3e-4. 1e-4 is a third of the pretraining peak, 3.3x the repeat; cosine decay to 0 over the 384 steps limits end-of-run drift (forgetting).
training.schedule: 19 linear warmup steps, then half-cosine decay to 0 at step 384 (--scheduler-num-cosine-cycles 0.5)
training.unchanged_from_e10_recipe: speculator dspark, block 8, markov rank 256, confidence head with markov, loss {ce 0.1, tv 0.9}, eager loss, optimizer muon (weight decay 0.1 Muon / 0 AdamW defaults), max anchors 1024, target layers 1/8/15/22/29, full verifier vocabulary

evaluation.method: speculators validation after one optimizer step at lr 0 (weights checked bitwise unchanged), same total_seq_len and seed for every head and set
evaluation.sets: each domain's 256 dev traces + the first 512 OPB held-out rows
evaluation.headline: eal_epoch matrix (heads e10, 6 domains, mixed) x (6 domain dev sets, OPB): diagonal gain vs off-diagonal and OPB change

gates.finite_losses: every logged training loss and both final validation losses finite
gates.real_updates: exported weights differ from e10 in at least one tensor
gates.export: exported tensors bitwise equal to the trained checkpoint, same names/shapes/dtypes as e10, config equal to e10 apart from the verifier path
gates.evaluation_unchanged: every lr-0 evaluation leaves its weights bitwise unchanged

confirmation: Queued after training, not part of this submission: each head vs e10 on its own domain, OPB and one far domain, k3/k7 x C1/C64, the GPU-swapped confirmation harness and calibrated correctness gate of the adaptation repeat.
verdict: Unchanged rule: >=10% throughput and >=10% lower median TPOT in both swaps; OPB/TTFT regressions make it a conditional tradeoff.
domain_naming: 'tool' is the data campaign's name for the structured/tool-calling domain (registered as 'structured' in the first design commit).
